title: VISIT LORNE
tickerText: *** BEAUTIFUL LORNE ***  ONE OF THE GREAT OCEAN ROAD’S MOST ICONIC SEASIDE TOWNS, LORNE IS FAMOUS FOR ITS BEAUTIFUL BEACHES, RELAXED ATMOSPHERE AND SPECTACULAR NATURAL SURROUNDINGS. SET ON THE TRADITIONAL LANDS OF THE EASTERN MAAR PEOPLE, LORNE HAS ATTRACTED HOLIDAYMAKERS FOR MORE THAN A CENTURY. SWIM OR SURF AT LOUTIT BAY, WANDER THE FORESHORE, EXPLORE ROCK POOLS OR CAST A LINE FROM THE HISTORIC LORNE PIER. JUST BEYOND TOWN, THE GREAT OTWAY NATIONAL PARK OFFERS ANCIENT FORESTS, GIANT FERNS AND MAGNIFICENT WATERFALLS, INCLUDING THE POPULAR ERSKINE FALLS. BACK IN TOWN, LORNE’S MAIN STRIP IS FILLED WITH CAFES, RESTAURANTS, BOUTIQUES, GALLERIES AND PLACES TO SETTLE IN AND WATCH THE WORLD GO BY. WHALES CAN BE SPOTTED OFFSHORE DURING THEIR ANNUAL MIGRATION, WHILE WALKING TRAILS REVEAL DRAMATIC VIEWS ALONG THE COAST. WITH A THRIVING ARTS SCENE, GREAT FOOD AND THE OTWAYS ON ITS DOORSTEP, LORNE COMBINES CLASSIC BEACH-TOWN CHARACTER WITH SOME OF VICTORIA’S MOST BEAUTIFUL SCENERY.
